source_title: holaboss-ai/holaOS: The agent environment for long-horizon work

key_discoveries.title: Environment Engineering Thesis
key_discoveries.description: The core thesis that the environment (runtime, memory, tools, workspace) defines agent capability more than the model itself. Validates our orchestrator approach where tmux isolation, git worktrees, and state management matter more than which LLM is used.

key_discoveries.title: Continuity Artifacts
key_discoveries.description: Structured outputs from previous runs that let agents resume long-horizon work without re-discovering context. Goes beyond chat history -- formalized state that survives session boundaries.

key_discoveries.title: Workspace Contract Model
key_discoveries.description: Each workspace defines a contract specifying what the agent can access and modify. Creates permission boundaries and security isolation. Authored surfaces (user-defined) vs runtime-owned state.

key_discoveries.title: Agent Harness Boundary
key_discoveries.description: Clean separation between executor (LLM calls) and environment (workspace + memory + tools). Swap models without changing workspace structure. The harness is the stable boundary; executors are pluggable.

key_discoveries.title: Independent / Headless Deploy
key_discoveries.description: The runtime can run without the Electron desktop app. Supports CI/server deployment and headless agent workflows. Validates that the agent OS concept works beyond interactive desktop use.
